entry.title: RT Milan Kovac: Here's a little more, and no cables this time ;) It's all real-time speed, zero CGI, fully learned in Simulation & zero-shot transferr...
entry.summary:
RT Milan Kovac Here's a little more, and no cables this time ;) It's all real-time speed, zero CGI, fully learned in Simulation & zero-shot transferred to real. Besides the fact that it's fun, we had to make significant improvements to our robot model in Sim, domain randomization and other techniques which will directly transfer to more practical situations as well (robust walking, and agile full-body control in general). We also learned quite a few things on our hardware and tuned our power profile. I hope it is getting pretty clear that Tesla is much more than an amazing car (!) company: it's the place to be for transformational real-world AI.
